Verifying what you submitted.
This wait is about verifying the information you submitted, not extracting it, which is already done. While that verification runs, only sending your data out to downstream partners is on hold. Everything else in your account is fully usable right now.
Once verification begins, visit the Verification Status tab to see results and any action requested of you. That's where outcomes appear first.
Learn more
An automated employer-verification database is checked first where it has coverage; anything it doesn't cover goes to a human verifier who attempts contact using independently-sourced information. If you've optionally provided a contact lead for a role or certification, that's checked against an independent listing first and only used if it holds up, never trusted on its own. Some items may end up permanently unable to verify despite that effort; that's shown honestly on Verification Status rather than hidden. None of this blocks you from using Profile Info, Views, Sharing, Subscription, or Activity in the meantime. It only holds back sending data to partners until it resolves.

What this is

A verified employment record. Upload your resume once, we render and confirm what's actually printed on it, and you get one portable, verified profile you control.

Why it matters

Employers and platforms get a verified fact set instead of a self-reported claim. You get one record instead of retyping your history everywhere you apply.

How much it costs

Free covers a fully verified profile with standard sharing controls. A paid tier adds convenience features, never a more accurate or more "verified" result. No tier is ever pre-selected for you.

Help me start

No resume handy, or not sure what counts? Chat with a guided assistant that walks through the upload step by step.
